title: When the Orchard Turns
author: Bram Okafor
blurb: Felix Blackwood, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
